title: was / were: Negative & Questions
grammarNote:
В прошлом уроке мы изучили утвердительные формы: "The weather WAS sunny." · "They WERE happy."

Теперь изучим, как делать ОТРИЦАНИЕ и задавать ВОПРОСЫ.

❌ ОТРИЦАНИЕ — добавляем NOT:
WAS + NOT → WASN'T (сокращение)
WERE + NOT → WEREN'T (сокращение)

"The professor WAS NOT happy." = "The professor WASN'T happy."
"My friends WERE NOT free." = "My friends WEREN'T free."

❓ ВОПРОС — переставляем was/were ПЕРЕД подлежащим:
"WAS the weather good?" — "No, it wasn't."
"WERE your friends with you?" — "Yes, they were!"
"WHERE WAS she in the morning?" — "She was at the lecture."

Примеры из диалога Daniyal и Ainur:
"Was the professor angry?" → "She wasn't happy — her face was stern!"
"Were you nervous?" → "Yes, I was very nervous at first."
"Where were you yesterday?" → "I was at the Debate Club!"

rows.example: "The weather wasn't warm — it was cold and rainy." · "She wasn't happy."
"My friends weren't free for lunch." · "The seats weren't empty."
"The soup was not hot." = "The soup wasn't hot." — оба правильны, wasn't разговорнее.
"They were not ready." = "They weren't ready." — оба правильны.
❌ "Not she was happy." ❌ "She not was happy." → ✅ "She wasn't happy." ✅ "She was not happy."
❌ "I weren't ready." → ✅ "I wasn't ready." (I → was/wasn't, не were/weren't!)
"Was the lecture interesting?" · "Was Ainur late?" · "Was it a good day, Daniyal?"
"Were you nervous before the debate?" · "Were your friends with you at lunch?"
"Where were you yesterday evening?" · "Where was Ainur in the afternoon?"
"What was the lecture like?" · "What was the weather like yesterday?" · "What was the quiz like?"
"How was your Monday?" → "It was a disaster!" · "How were the questions?" → "Very difficult!"
❌ "The lecture was interesting?" → ✅ "Was the lecture interesting?" (was/were ПЕРЕД подлежащим!)

"Yes, it WAS!" ✅ · "No, it WASN'T." ✅
❌ "Yes, it was good." ❌ "Yes." (без was — неполный ответ!)

"Yes, I WAS!" ✅ · "No, I WASN'T." ✅
❌ "Yes, I was nervous." ❌ "Yes, was." (без подлежащего!)

"Yes, they WERE!" ✅ · "No, they WEREN'T." ✅
❌ "Yes, they were busy." (повтор прилагательного лишний)
Yes/No + subject (I/he/she/it/you/we/they) + was/were/wasn't/weren't.
❌ "Yes, it wasn't." (противоречие!) · ❌ "Yes, it was." — сокращение ТУТ возможно, но в ответе не нужно.
"Was the professor angry?" → "She wasn't happy." · "Were you nervous?" → "Yes, I was very nervous!"

grammarExtra.title: was/were в прошлом vs. am/is/are сейчас

rows.example: "The weather IS sunny today." · "Ainur IS a Medicine student." · "I AM happy now."
"The weather WAS cold yesterday." · "Ainur WAS late this morning." · "I WAS nervous."
"Today the cafeteria IS busy." vs. "Yesterday the cafeteria WAS crowded and the soup WAS cold."
"Is the lecture interesting?" (сейчас) vs. "Was the lecture interesting?" (вчера?)
"She isn't happy." (сейчас) vs. "She wasn't happy." (вчера — о профессоре Ainur)
"Yesterday, last week, two days ago, on Monday, in October" → всегда was/were, НЕ is/are!

grammarTip:
Четыре шага для was/were в вопросах и отрицаниях:

① ОТРИЦАНИЕ — добавь NOT после was/were:
   "It was cold." → "It WASN'T cold."
   "They were busy." → "They WEREN'T busy."
   Запомни: was + not = WASN'T · were + not = WEREN'T

② ВОПРОС — поставь was/were ПЕРЕД подлежащим:
   "It was cold." → "WAS it cold?"
   "They were busy." → "WERE they busy?"
   "The lecture was interesting." → "WAS the lecture interesting?"

③ КРАТКИЙ ОТВЕТ — только subject + was/were:
   "Was it good?" → "Yes, it WAS." / "No, it WASN'T."
   "Were they ready?" → "Yes, they WERE." / "No, they WEREN'T."
   ⚠️ Никогда не повторяй прилагательное: ❌ "Yes, it was good."

④ Не путай I/he/she/it с you/we/they:
   ❌ "I weren't ready." → ✅ "I WASN'T ready."
   ❌ "They wasn't free." → ✅ "They WEREN'T free."

exercises.text: Ainur ___ ready for the unexpected quiz at all.
exercises.hint: Ainur = she = singular → WASN'T. "She WASN'T ready." ✅ (weren't = you/we/they)

exercises.text: The cafeteria tables ___ empty — every seat was taken.
exercises.hint: Tables = they = plural → WEREN'T. "The tables WEREN'T empty." ✅

exercises.text: You want to ask: "Was Daniyal nervous before the debate?"
exercises.hint: Daniyal = he = singular → WAS. Question: WAS + subject + adjective? ✅ Was/were goes BEFORE the subject.

exercises.text: "Was the lecture interesting?" — "Yes, it was interesting." is a correct short answer.
exercises.hint: Short answers don't repeat the adjective! → "Yes, it WAS." ✅ "Yes, it was interesting." is too long — just subject + was.

exercises.text: "Were Ainur's friends with her at lunch?" — ___
exercises.hint: "They" = plural → WEREN'T. Short answer: "No, they WEREN'T." ✅ ("wasn't" = only for I/he/she/it)

exercises.instruction: Write the correct question word + was/were.
exercises.text: "___ you yesterday evening, Daniyal?" — "I was at the Debate Club!"
exercises.hint: Asking about location in the past → "Where WERE you?" (you = were). "WHERE WERE you yesterday?"
I → was / WASN'T (not weren't). → "I WASN'T nervous." ✅ "weren't" is only for you/we/they.

exercises.text: Which pair of sentences is completely correct?
opts: The soup wasn't cold. Were the tables full?
The soup weren't cold. Was the tables full?
The soup wasn't hot. Were the tables empty?
The soup wasn't hot. Was the tables empty?
exercises.correct: The soup wasn't hot. Were the tables empty?
exercises.hint: "soup" = singular → WASN'T ✅. "tables" = plural → WERE ✅. "Were the tables empty?" ✅
